paite: Pentikost ni ahong tun in, avek un mun khat ah a-omkhawm uhi.
heading: Kha Siangthou Tunna / (Joe 2.28-32)
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

paite: Thakhat in van a kipan huihpi nung bang in ging ahong om guih a, huchi in huai in atutna inn uh ahihdim vekta hi,
english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

paite: leite amah-le-amah mei bang a kihawm in, alutung uah ahong tuang chiat hi.
english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

paite: Huchi in avek un Kha Siangthou in aluahdimta a, Kha in hihtheihna apiak a apausak bang zel in pau dangte in apauta uhi.
english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

paite: Huan van nuai nam chih lak a kipan Pathian limsak Juda kulmutte Jerusalem ah a-om uhi.
english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

paite: Huan ging husa azaktak un mipi ahong kikhawm ua, michih in apau uh amau pau chiat a azak ziak un alungsim uh ahong buai hi.
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

paite: Huan avek un amangbang ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi, "En dih uh, hiai a pau tengteng Galili gam a mi ahi kei ua hia?
english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

paite: Bangchi in ahia i vek ua pianpih pau chiat a i zak uh?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

paite: Eite Parthai nam, Medes nam, Elam nam; khenkhat Mesopotamia gam a om, Judia gam a om, Kappadosia gam a om, Pontas gam a om, Asia gam a om,
english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

paite: Phrigia gam a om, Pamphilia gam a om, Aigupta gam a om, Kurini kho kiang a Libia gam a om i hi ua; khenkhat Rome a pan mikhualte, Judate leh aphungkaite uh toh i hi ngal ua,
english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

paite: khenkhat Krit tuikulh leh Arab gam a mite i hi ngal ua; himahleh, Pathian thilhih thupite agen uh eimau pau chiat in i za ngal ua!" achi uhi.
english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

paite: Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, akhiakna dan thei lou in, "Hiai bangchidan ahia?" akichi uhi.
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

paite: Khenkhat in, "Uain thak akham ua ahi," chi in anuihsan uhi.
english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

paite: Himahleh Peter in sawm-le-khatte toh dingkhawm in, aw ngaihtak in akiang uah agen a, nou Judia gam a mite aw, nou Jerusalem a om tengteng aw, hiai thei unla, ka thu leng ngaikhia un.
heading: Peter Thugen
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

paite: Hiaite na gin bang un akham kei uh, dak thumna hun ahi.
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

paite: Hiaite zawlnei Joel in agen ahi zaw:
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

paite: "Pathian in, ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding, mi tengteng tung ah ka kha ka sungbo ding a; na tapa leh na tanute'n ka thu ahilh ding uh; na tangvalte un kilaknate amu ding ua, na putekte un mang anei ding uh.
english: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

paite: Ahi, huai ni in ka sikhapate, ka sikhanute tung ah leng ka Kha ka sungbo ding a, ka thu agen ding uhi.
english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

paite: Huan tunglam van ah thillamdang nuailam lei ah chiamtehna ka musak ding a; sisan, mei, meikhu hu toh,
english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

paite: Nisa mial asuak ding a, kha sisan asuak ding, Toupa ni thupitak leh lauhuaitak ahong tun ma in.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Toupa min lou peuhmah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

paite: "Nou Israel mite aw, hiai thu za un: Nazaret Jesu, Pathian in amah zang in na lak uah thil thupite, thillamdangte, chiamtehnate ahih in ahon theichiansak hi; nou ngei in tuate na theichian uhi.
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

paite: Huai mi Pathian' tupkholhsa leh theihkholh bang in na mansak ua, nou migiloute khut a kilhden in na hihlumta uhi.
english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

paite: Amah, Pathian in sihna thuaknatna phelsak in, akaithouta a; ama sihna letdet vual ahih louh ziak in.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

paite: Huan David in athu agen a, 'Ka ma ah chik lai peuh in Toupa ka mu gige hi. Ka mangbatlouhna ding in ka taklam ah a-om hi.
english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lungtang anuam a, ka lei leng akipak a, ka sa lamentak in a-om behlap lai hi.
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

paite: Misikhua ah ka kha na nuse kei ding a, muatna na Mi Siangthou na musak sam kei ding hi.
english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

paite: Nangma'n hinna lampite na hon theisak a; nangma'n na mel in kipak in na hon hihdim ding,'" chi in.
english: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

paite: "Unaute aw, chikhahpa David thu lau lou in na kiang uah ka gen thei hi; amah zaw asi a, vui leng avui khinta ua, ahan leng tutan in i kiang ah a-om lai hi.
english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

paite: Amah tuh zawlnei ahi a, Pathian in akhal a mi kuahiam sadan a achite lak a mi khat Khrist laltutphah a tu ding in akaithou ding chih kichiam in agen chih athei hi.
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

paite: Huchi in huai tuh atheihkholh him ziak in Khrist thohnawn ding thu agen hi, 'Misikhua a nutsiat in a-om kei a, aluang leng amuat sam kei hi, chi in.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

paite: "Pathian in Jesu akaithouta chih theihpihte i vek un i hi uhi.
english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

paite: Pathian khut taklam ah pahtawi in a-om a, Kha Siangthou chiam Pa kiang a kipan in amu a, na muh uh leh na zakte uh ahon sunbuak ahi uhi.
english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

paite: David zaw van ah akahtou kei, amah ngei in, Jehovah in ka Toupa kiang ah,
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

paite: 'Na melmate na khepek ngakna dia ka bawl masiah, Ka taklam ah tu kinken in,' " achi, ana chi hi.
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

paite: "Huchi in Jesu, na kilhden uh, Pathian in Toupa leh Khrist hikhawm in abawlta chih Israel inkuan chih in kichiantak in thei uhen," achi hi.
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

paite: Huan huai thu azak un alungtang ua sut bang ahong hi ua, Peter leh sawltak dangte kiang ah, "Unaute aw, bangchi in ka hihta ding ua?" achi ua.
heading: Piangthak Masate
english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

paite: Peter in akiang uah, "Na khelhnate uh ngaihdamna ding in lungsim khek unla, Jesu Khrist min in baptisma tang chiat un; huchi in Kha Siangthou thawnpiak na tang ding uhi.
english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

paite: Achiam nou a ding, na tate uh a ding, gamlapi a mi tengteng a ding leh Toupa i Pathian in akiang a asap peuhmahte a ding ahi," achi hi.
english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

paite: Huan thudang tampi in ahilhchian a; hiai khang thulimloute lak ah kihumbit un, chi in ahanthawn hi.
english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

paite: Huan athu zui peuhmah in baptisma atang ua, huai ni in mi sangthum vel behlap in a-om uhi.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

paite: Huan sawltakte thusinsakte sin in, kithuah in, tanghou balkham in, thum in, phatuamngaitak in a-omkhawm uhi.
english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

paite: Huan michih in alauta ua; sawltakte'n thillamdang leh chiam-tehna tampi ahih uhi.
heading: Saptuam Masate Hihna
english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

paite: Agingta peuhmah in bangkim akikopkhawm uhi.
english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

paite: Agoute uh, athil neihte uh azuak ua, adeihdong ching lel chiat in avek ua kiang ah ahawm zel uhi.
english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

paite: Huan niteng in, lungsim mun khat in, tempul ah phatuamngaitak in a-om zelzel ua, a-innte uah leng tanghou balkham in, nuam leh lungkim in, a-an uh ane zel uhi.
english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

paite: Pathian aphat ua, mi tengteng deihsak in a-om uhi. Huan ahotdam lel peuhmah Toupa'n niteng in akiang uah abehlapsak zel hi.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
